name: Himawari
source:
A small former mining village is almost fully destroyed by a tsunami. The main character goes to teach in Tokyo, but he eventually returns. He is greeted coldly by the remaining villagers, and his heart shrinks even further. That is until he meets a girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
